mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') order by dept_id

select p.*, d.dept_name as dept_name, d.dept_type as dept_type, d.leader as dept_leader, d.status as dept_status, u.nick_name as employee_name, u.phonenumber as phone_number, u.email as employee_email, u.sex as employee_sex, u.remark as employee_remark, upc.post_names, u.status as linked_account_status, u.del_flag as linked_account_del_flag, u.user_name as linked_account_user_name , hc.certificate_id as health_certificate_id , hc.expires_on as health_certificate_expires_on from sys_user_profile p inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id left join hr_employee_health_certificate hc on hc.user_id = p.user_id and hc.certificate_id =
and coalesce(hc.valid_from,hc.issued_date) <= #{asOfDate} left join ( select sup.user_id, group_concat(distinct sp.post_name order by sp.post_sort, sp.post_name separator '、') as post_names from sys_user_post sup inner join sys_post sp on sp.post_id = sup.post_id where sp.status = '0' group by sup.user_id ) upc on upc.user_id = p.user_id where p.dept_id is not null and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and 1 = 1
and 1 = 0
and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept root where root.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and (p.dept_id = root.dept_id or find_in_set(root.dept_id, d.ancestors)) ) and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept auth where auth.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and (p.dept_id = auth.dept_id or find_in_set(auth.dept_id, d.ancestors)) )
and 1 = 0
order by p.dept_id, p.profile_id

select c.certificate_id, c.user_id, u.dept_id as dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_type, p.employee_no, u.nick_name as employee_name, c.certificate_no, c.review_status, c.rejection_reason, c.create_time, c.update_time from hr_employee_health_certificate c inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' left join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = c.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where c.del_flag = '0'
or (c.review_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept root where root.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and (u.dept_id = root.dept_id or find_in_set(root.dept_id, d.ancestors)) )
and 1 = 0
)
or (c.review_status in ('REJECTED', 'RETURNED') and c.user_id = #{userId})
order by c.create_time, c.certificate_id
